regions.region: page 1 title, abstract, graphical abstract, and article metadata
regions.finding: Verified the actual article title and aggregate copper-catalyzed allenic C(sp2)-H alkynylation claim. The graphical abstract is a generic transformation, not an experiment-specific run.

regions.region: page 1 introduction, Figure 1 citations, and natural-product discussion
regions.finding: The page introduces natural-product allenynes and cited prior synthetic/HAT chemistry. Natural-product structures are context, while the generic prior/current reaction classes are classified in Figure 1 records continued on page 2.

regions.region: page 1 Supporting Information link
regions.finding: The paper advertises online Supporting Information, but workspace association remains unestablished; no SI procedure or characterization fact was imported.

unresolved: Figure 1 generic R groups do not define unique structures or experiment-specific conditions.
No workspace SI association is established.

regions.region: page 2 left Figure 1 panels A–D
regions.finding: Panel A is natural-product context; panel B is cited prior synthesis; panel C is prior radical alkane alkynylation; panel D is the current generic reaction concept. None is assigned a Table 1 or scope-row yield.

regions.region: page 2 upper-right Table 1 reaction header, alkyne structures I–III, HAT reagent, entries 1–6, and footnote
regions.finding: All six optimization/control rows were recorded independently with shared charges/conditions, the row-specific alkyne identity or omitted Cu/dtbbpy/HAT component, and 16/0/75/0/0/0% outcomes.

regions.region: page 2 lower-right Scheme 1 introduction and scope prose
regions.finding: The prose maps to the 38 distinct Scheme 1 products on page 3, including no radical-clock ring opening for 3o and functional-group tolerance; no narrative duplicates were created.

unresolved: Table 1 omits workup, purification, masses, and yield basis.
Scope structures remain source-labeled where safe stereochemical encoding was uncertain.

regions.region: page 3 Scheme 1 reaction header, product grid 3a–3al, caption, and footnotes a–e
regions.finding: All 38 displayed substrate-scope arrows were retained separately with 1/III/Cu/dtbbpy/N-F reagent/PhCl quantities, isolated yields, and row-specific CuBr·CH3SCH3 or 60/70/77 h overrides.

regions.region: page 3 lower two-column scope discussion
regions.finding: The prose maps functional-group/site-selectivity statements and non-ring-opening observations to the existing Scheme 1 rows; it introduces the five Scheme 2 alkynylating-reagent rows and Scheme 3 applications without duplicating them.

regions.region: page 3 Scheme 3 narrative continuation
regions.finding: The page states that 1a scale-up gives a comparable yield and that 3a/6 undergo six transformations. The full arrows and exact displayed conditions occur on page 4 and are represented once with cross-page evidence.

unresolved: Scheme 1/2 omit row-specific workup, purification, and isolated masses.
Most Scheme 3 application yield bases are not explicitly stated.

regions.region: page 4 upper-left Scheme 2 header, five product arrows, caption
regions.finding: Recorded five distinct 1d/2a–2e scope experiments, each with common charges/conditions and isolated product yield 64/65/51/47/58%.

regions.region: page 4 center-left Scheme 3A scale-up and Scheme 3B six transformation arrows
regions.finding: Recorded the independent 1.0 mmol 1a scale-up (3a, 68%) and six product transformations to 4–9. Footnote reagents and every displayed amount/volume/loading are participants; the 3a→9 arrow is split into 24 h addition and 15 min acid-treatment stages with both temperatures explicitly missing.

regions.region: page 4 upper-right Scheme 4A radical-clock experiment
regions.finding: Recorded allene 11 under standard conditions to ring-opened product 12 (18%); proposed resonance/pathway intermediates I–III were not treated as preparations.

regions.region: page 4 center-right Scheme 4B radical trapping
regions.finding: TEMPO and BHT at 2 equiv are separate control experiments. Both give trace 3a/complete inhibition; possible BHT-derived 10/10' are retained as MS-detected candidate products.

regions.region: page 4 lower-right Scheme 4C Hammett plot
regions.finding: Recorded one X=OMe/Me/H/Cl/CN kinetic series with the printed fit y=0.0033x+0.0389 and the stated negligible electronic effect; graph point values were not estimated.

unresolved: Scheme 3/4 omit several absolute scales, workups, purifications, masses, yield bases, detection limits, or analytical details.
The temperatures for both 3a→9 stages are not printed and remain null/missing.

regions.region: page 5 Figure 2A transmetalation energy profile
regions.finding: Classified INT1–INT3 and TS1/TS2 as computed states. Relative energies 0.0/9.4/11.3/21.5/−6.2 kcal/mol and the 10.2 kcal/mol TS difference are retained as mechanism data, not reaction yields.

regions.region: page 5 Figure 2B radical addition versus HAT
regions.finding: Retained printed radical-addition barriers 8.9/10.5/16.5 kcal/mol and HAT barriers 9.8/7.3 kcal/mol in the DFT record. Computed transition states are not experiments.

regions.region: page 5 Figure 2C C–H data and explanatory prose
regions.finding: Retained 1ah C–Ha/C–Hb BDE values 82.1/77.3 kcal/mol and corresponding activation energies. The discussion continues on page 6 and is linked to the same DFT record.

unresolved: The unassociated SI contains further computational details/coordinates and was not imported.
Computed labels and geometries remain machine-unverified.

regions.region: page 6 upper-left continuation of Figure 2 discussion
regions.finding: The text confirms the 7.3 kcal/mol lowest HAT barrier and −25.0 kcal/mol exergonicity for C–Hb and interprets the BDE/selectivity trends; it enriches the existing Figure 2 mechanism record.

regions.region: page 6 center-left Scheme 5 proposed mechanism
regions.finding: Classified NCR and intermediates A–C as a proposed Cu(I)/Cu(II) radical-relay cycle, not isolated preparations; allene 1, alkynylating reagent, and product 3 are mechanistic endpoints.

regions.region: page 6 right-column conclusion, Associated Content, and author information
regions.finding: Conclusion and author metadata add no new experiment. The article advertises online experimental procedures/characterization, but no workspace SI association is established and no SI-only fact was inferred.

unresolved: Proposed intermediates have no independent observation status or quantities.
The Supporting Information link does not establish a workspace SI association.
